maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from producing and selling natural gas, plus power generation; not repair or servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Natural gas and power sold to commercial markets, utilities and private buyers, not paid mainly by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through gas production, midstream, power and carbon capture development in the Barnett, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Natural gas and electricity are largely commodity products that buyers can source from other suppliers fairly easily.

notes: Mission-critical judged on commodity gas being the larger business; power contracts with hyperscalers may be stickier.
